title: CATS OPA Routing Input
description: Schema for the input object sent to OPA routing policy. Must be kept in sync with routing.rego and tactical_agent.py.

gateway_inflight.description: Number of concurrent requests the gateway has dispatched to this site and not yet received a response for.

compute_util.description: GPU utilization (cloud) or CPU utilization (edge), percentage.

predicted_latency_ms.description: Composite end-to-end estimate: network_latency + total_inference_avg + queue_penalty.

sla_target_ms.description: SLA latency target in milliseconds. Dynamic per request_tag.
